title: simplify-buildx-cache-and-introduce-dependency-rotation-policy
author: Noah Chen
description: Motivation: CI build times and dependency churn were driving noisy automation PRs and long image rebuilds. This PR reduces CI noise by consolidating Docker buildx cache usage, introducing a dependency-rotation policy that batches routine updates, and simplifying the build image to a single curated builder stage. Goals: 1) reduce cold-cache Docker build time and network egress by relying on a shared buildx cache exported to the registry and a short-lived local cache during matrix runs; 2) replace the ad-hoc dep-batching scripts with a rotation policy (tools/dep-rotation) that opens a single weekly PR per dependency group and auto-closes outdated branches; 3) shrink and standardize the build image and remove legacy Apt installs so image build is reproducible across runners. Changes summary: - Add .github/workflows/buildx-cache.yml to manage cache export/import and a lightweight cache-health check job; - Introduce tools/dep-rotation/rotate.py and a manifest (tools/dep-rotation/groups.yaml) that maps package groups to rotation cadence; - Replace the monolithic Dockerfile.build with ci/docker/Dockerfile.builder (distroless runtime removed from builder stage) and move runtime trimming to a separate publish step; - Add scripts/scripts-prune-cache.sh to aggressively prune local builder layers on ephemeral runners; - Update .github/actions/setup-buildx composite action pin to github-actions/setup-buildx@v2.2.0 and bump docker/login-action to v2 to support OCI cache exports; - Documentation: docs/ci/dep-rotation.md and docs/ci/buildx-cache.md; - Backwards-compatible: existing release hooks unchanged, rotation policy opted-in per repo via tools/dep-rotation/groups.yaml checklist: - [x] Add buildx cache import/export workflow and health checks - [x] Implement rotation tool and manifest - [x] Update Docker builder image and remove deprecated packages - [x] Add docs and a migration note for repo maintainers - [x] Run full CI matrix and measured improvement (see CI summary) Migration notes: repo maintainers should: 1) add their package groups to tools/dep-rotation/groups.yaml to opt into rotation; 2) update any custom build steps that relied on the old Dockerfile.build layer ordering; 3) validate that any self-hosted runners have experimental buildx support enabled. Impact: measured median cold-start builder time improved by ~18% on our nightly benchmark job; noise from automated dependency PRs dropped by consolidating minor updates into weekly rotation PRs in a canary sample of 12 repos. Related: ENG-8421 (reduce CI cost), ENG-9122 (release automation hygiene).
commits: feat(ci): add buildx cache import/export workflow and health job
chore(dep-rotation): add rotation tool + groups manifest
refactor(ci/docker): replace Dockerfile.build with Dockerfile.builder and split publish step
chore(scripts): add scripts-prune-cache.sh and runner cleanup
docs(ci): add dep-rotation and buildx-cache docs and migration guide
review_comments: Ava Martinez: Nice consolidation. Can we add a short-circuit when registry OCI cache is unavailable? Otherwise builds hang for the matrix.
Noah Chen: Added a cache-health check job that falls back to a short-lived local cache; documented behavior in docs/ci/buildx-cache.md.
Priya Kapoor: The rotation tool looks good but we should ensure we don't exceed rate limits when opening multiple PRs across repos.
Noah Chen: Rotation tool now includes a randomized backoff and per-org rate limiter; added to groups.yaml schema.
James Park: Please add a note for self-hosted runner admins about enabling buildkit experimental mode.
Noah Chen: Added migration note and a script to detect unsupported runners and fail early in the workflow.
ci_checks: buildx-cache-health (passed on canary, fallback exercised once)
release_notes: Improve CI: shared buildx cache, dependency rotation tool to batch routine updates, smaller builder image. Measured ~18% faster cold builder start and less dep-PR noise. Maintainers: opt-in via tools/dep-rotation/groups.yaml and review migration steps in docs/ci/dep-rotation.md.
notes: Hotfixes: none. Rollout: scheduled canary on 12 repos for 2 weeks before org-wide enablement. Observability: added cache-health metric to infra dashboard and an alert on cache import failure rate >5%.
